summary: Scorpio Tankers Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 5, 2026, reporting its first-quarter 2026 financial results. The filing also announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.45 per common share declared on May 4, 2026, payable June 15, 2026, to shareholders of record May 29, 2026, and an increase (replenishment to $500 million) of its existing Securities Repurchase Program. These actions represent routine capital allocation decisions, not a special situation such as a tender offer, going-private transaction, or activist campaign. No extraordinary corporate event or structural change is disclosed.
